summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk filed a Form 6-K reporting execution on September 30, 2026 of the Deed of Spin-Off of its wholesale fiber connectivity business segment from Telkom into PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF), approved by an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders that same day. The capital increase at TIF is expected effective October 1, 2026, after approval and notification of TIF's amended articles of incorporation to Indonesia's Ministry of Law. Post-spin, Telkom's TIF ownership rises marginally from 99.9999997% to 99.9999999%, with PT Multimedia Nusantara's stake falling to 0.0000001%. No price, premium, advisor, or close deadline stated; watch progress of ministerial approvals and any future TIF monetization or listing.
